description: This file defines an 'Education' display field class for reporting within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a listable display field class and provides specific entity and field configurations related to employee education data.

classes.name: Education
classes.description: A display field class for employee education data, providing directory-specific DTO class, entity aliases, and fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name for the Education DTO.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity alias names used within reporting queries.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields related to employee education.
